scripts.build: bun run --filter @ares-slicer/wasm build && bun run --filter @ares-slicer/profiles build && bun run --filter ares-app build
scripts.dev: bun run --filter @ares-slicer/wasm build && bun run --filter @ares-slicer/profiles build && bun run --filter ares-app dev
scripts.lint: bun lint --no-script --max-warnings=0 packages app e2e pages
scripts.fmt: bun fmt --no-script packages app e2e pages
scripts.fmt:check: bun fmt --no-script --check packages app e2e pages
scripts.typecheck: bun check --no-script -p packages/ares-wasm-js/tsconfig.json && bun check --no-script -p app/tsconfig.json && bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.json
scripts.prepare:e2e: cargo build --release -p ares-cli --bin ares -p ares-core --example print_config_def && cargo nextest run -p ares-wasm --test compatible_presets --test decoded_settings --test encode_roundtrip && bun scripts/build-panic-probe.mjs && bun run build:wasm && bun run build && cargo nextest list -p ares-cli --test orca_parity -E 'test(=runner::config_block_roundtrip::config_block_encode_inverts_decode)'
scripts.test:e2e: bun run prepare:e2e && bunx playwright test
scripts.build:pages: bun run build:wasm && bun run build && bun scripts/package-pages.mjs
